create_maskdata_store_masks: create a MaskData object to store and filter batched segmentation masks and related data
encode_masks_to_rle: encode a batch of binary mask tensors to uncompressed RLE format for pycoco tools
calculate_mask_stability_score: calculate the stability score as IoU between high and low thresholded mask logits
